Yoiful.note: The product name. Never translated, never given an article.

card.note: A prepaid gift card a business issues to a customer. It has a code like YGFT-AB12, a QR code and a balance. Feminine in Spanish (la tarjeta), so its statuses are feminine: activa, congelada, agotada, cancelada.

balance.note: The money left on a card.

load.note: Adding money to a card. As a button it is 'Add funds' (Agregar fondos). As a transaction type (noun) it is 'Carga'.

charge.note: Taking money off a card for a purchase. Verb on buttons ('Cobrar'); as a transaction type (noun) it is 'Cobro'. Not 'cargo'.

adjust.note: A manual correction of a card's balance, with a required note. Verb 'Ajustar'; noun (transaction type) 'Ajuste'.

frozen.note: A card status: blocked on purpose, cannot be charged or loaded until unfrozen. Freeze = congelar, unfreeze = descongelar.

depleted.note: A card status: the balance reached zero.

business.note: The customer of Yoiful: a café, bakery or shop that issues cards. Same thing as 'organization' in admin screens.

organization.note: A business, as the superadmin area calls it. Feminine: activa, suspendida, cancelada.

cardholder.note: The person who holds a card. They have no account.

reader.note: The staff screen that scans a card's QR code to add funds or charge it.

program.note: A card program of a business (v1 has one, 'Gift Card' / 'Tarjeta de regalo').

superadmin.note: A Yoiful staff member who manages every business. Kept as is in Spanish.

owner.note: A membership role: the business owner.

manager.note: A membership role between owner and employee.

employee.note: A membership role: staff who scan and charge cards.
